en: A black and white postcard image showing a wide river or canal lined by trees, with a graceful arched bridge (Spiköbron) crossing over it. There are a few buildings visible in the background, situated among a lightly forested area. The scene looks calm and picturesque, typical of early to mid-20th-century postcards. There is Swedish text at the bottom and a publisher mark.
